findings.source_passage: this earthly air, whether ashore or afloat, is terribly infected with the nameless miseries of the numberless mortals who have died exhaling it
findings.why_it_matters: The full tobacco-as-disinfectant conceit — the cholera/camphorated-handkerchief analogy explaining how Stubb's pipe wards off mortal misery — is one of Melville's distinctive philosophical asides; the draft collapses it to a half-sentence ('what made him so cheerily impious against mortal tribulations?—his pipe, perhaps') losing the voice and the interpretive content entirely.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the cholera/camphor analogy in compressed but recognizable form: 'this earthly air, ashore or afloat, terribly infected with the miseries of all who have died exhaling it; against such contagion, Stubb's tobacco might have operated as a disinfecting agent.'

findings.source_passage: what he thought of death itself, there is no telling. Whether he ever thought of it at all, might be a question; but, if he ever did chance to cast his mind that way after a comfortable dinner, no doubt, like a good sailor, he took it to be a sort of call of the watch to tumble aloft
findings.why_it_matters: This passage is the philosophical and tonal capstone of the Stubb portrait — Melville's wry, voice-defining meditation on Stubb's casual relationship with death. It gives Stubb his philosophical dimension and is a minor critical touchstone. The draft cuts it entirely.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore in brief: 'What he thought of death itself, there is no telling — whether he ever thought of it at all. If he did, he likely took it, like a good sailor, as a call of the watch to tumble aloft about something he'd find out when he obeyed, and not sooner.'

findings.source_passage: he presided over his whale-boat as if the most deadly encounter were but a dinner, and his crew all invited guests
findings.why_it_matters: This is among Melville's most rhetorically distinctive similes for Stubb — it establishes the exact social-comic register that makes the character memorable. The draft omits it entirely in favour of a bare catalogue of traits.
findings.suggested_fix: Insert the dinner/invited-guests simile when characterizing Stubb's command style in the draft's opening paragraph.

findings.source_passage: going about with a camphorated handkerchief to their mouths; so, likewise, against all mortal tribulations, Stubb's tobacco smoke might have operated as a sort of disinfecting agent
findings.why_it_matters: The specific cholera/camphor image is a period-register marker and a signature analogy; losing it also loses the semi-comic medical logic that grounds the passage.
findings.suggested_fix: See fix for the medium finding above — restoring the broader passage subsumes this one.

findings.source_passage: to look at the tawny brawn of his lithe snaky limbs, you would almost have credited the superstitions of some of the earlier Puritans, and half-believed this wild Indian to be a son of the Prince of the Powers of the Air
findings.why_it_matters: This Puritan-supernatural aside is the most distinctive rhetorical flourish in the Tashtego description and carries interpretive weight about how the crew is perceived within American mythological frameworks; the draft reduces Tashtego to bare physical description.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a clause: 'his lithe, snaky limbs might almost have made the earlier Puritans credit him a son of the Prince of the Powers of the Air.'

summary: The draft loses three medium-severity passages — the death-and-the-watch philosophical coda, the dinner-party simile, and the entire tobacco-as-disinfectant conceit — that together constitute the main voice-defining and interpretively weighted material in the Stubb portrait, triggering regeneration.
